# Active-ESL

> Application-ready connected embedded platforms. Build your application, not your platform.

- Site: https://active-esl.com/
- Contact: https://active-esl.com/contact.html
- Email: info@active-esl.com
- Legal entity: Active-Edge Solutions Ltd (company number 14105473)

## Products

- EDGE LITE — compact i.MX 8M Mini connected platform
- EDGE GATEWAY — adaptable multi-radio communications platform
- Roadmap: EDGE RT / Zephyr (i.MX RT + Mender OTA), EDGE PI, tablet/HMI and low-power variants

## Software

- Lifecycle Platform: Build · Deploy · Sustain
- Application processors: Yocto/OpenEmbedded Linux via FoundriesFactory / Linux microPlatform path
- MCU / i.MX RT: Zephyr with secure OTA updates using Mender

## Case studies

- Compact voice and edge AI
- Adaptable communications
- Distributed motorsport sensing
